question: Can the constant-velocity ball forecast be ISSUED through an operational path (opportunity -> inputs available by the cutoff -> causal state -> forecast or named abstention -> immutable journal) whose every record is provably independent of the future, and then EVALUATED later against references matched by a declared policy?
evidence_class: engineering + retrospective replay of offline motion capture; not a live deployment

source.dataset: SPL Open Data free-throw motion capture (MLSE Sport Performance Lab)
source.units: source feet converted to metres once, at load (wms.data.mlse_spl.FEET_TO_METERS)
source.stream: ball centre only; body and hand landmarks are not inputs to this forecaster

availability.rule: a sample becomes available at its own native timestamp
availability.why: offline motion capture has no recorded arrival time; zero latency is DECLARED, not measured, and a live source must replace it with measured availability

opportunities.last: latest opportunity at or before the stream close (the last available sample)
opportunities.never: a whole-trial statistic (e.g. a median interval) or any later sample

target.never: the timestamp of whichever reference sample later turns out to exist

causal_velocity_v1.definition: secant over the two most recent available ball samples at or before the cutoff: (p_last - p_prev) / (t_last - t_prev), m/ms

minimum_history.rule: the most recent sample at or before cutoff - 267 ms must exist, and every ball sample from it through the latest sample at or before the cutoff must be finite (E1's complete-prefix rule, applied at the cutoff)

causal_acceleration_v1.definition: second divided difference over the three most recent available ball samples at or before the cutoff, m/ms^2

minimum_history.rule: the three most recent samples at or before the cutoff are finite with strictly increasing times

prefix_phase_v1.definition: a phase label inferred from the prefix only (gather / set / release / flight), never the retrospective release proxy
prefix_phase_v1.minimum_history: declared by the phase model that implements it
prefix_phase_v1.status: MISSING: requires a causal phase model (R6-M M6); not faked here

forecaster.rule: p_last + v * (target_requested_ms - t_last), with v = causal_velocity_v1

journal.format: JSON lines; canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, no NaN); each line carries seq and the sha256 of the previous line; a final seal line carries the record count and the last line's sha256
journal.write: exclusive create; a journal is never rewritten, and evaluation is a separate file

evaluation.policy: nearest native sample to target_requested_ms within tolerance_ms, ties to the earlier sample; the reference must be strictly after the issue time and have a finite ball

outcomes.pending: the evaluation clock has not yet passed target_requested_ms + tolerance_ms
outcomes.unscoreable: the tolerance window has passed with no usable reference (reason recorded)

evaluation.evaluation_clock: the latest available sample time of the stream (for an offline trial, its last sample)

not_claimed: live latency: availability is declared at zero, not measured
any accuracy improvement: this is the same constant-velocity forecaster E1 uses, issued causally
phase-aware issuance: prefix_phase_v1 is declared but not implemented
